descFull: Check Risk WAF is an all-in-one Web Application Firewall with Anti-Bot and Anti-DDoS protection at L3, L4, and L7. Available on-premises or as SaaS, it protects web apps against OWASP Top 10 attacks, CWE vulnerabilities, botnets, and DoS/DDoS. Free and unlimited for everyone, forever for personal, non-commercial use.
